Equipped with 253.7nm UV‑C light and 40,000Hz ultrasonic waves, this mattress vacuum penetrates deep into fabric layers to help reduce surface dust. Gravity‑sensing design ensures safe use on beds and sofas.

【Multi‑Layer Filtration & Safety Protection】
A high‑efficiency HEPA filter captures 99.97% of fine dust as small as 0.3 microns, helping maintain stable suction performance. Safety protections include rotor lock, overheating, over‑current, and short‑circuit safeguards for reliable long‑term use.
